retrievalLimitations: No current official comprehensive last-known-information or every multi-target priority ruling was newly obtained.
No PTCG Live behavior or log is used as a rules authority.
No Japanese, Asian or community source is mixed into the international ruleset.
implementationLimits: Supports named public Pokémon bindings for resumable Trainer and activated-Ability programs, in addition to the existing attack continuation bindings.
Each binding records server owner, instance identity and in-play entry sequence; an object that left play or re-entered is not substituted.
Automatic triggered effects, replacement effects and last-known-information predicates remain outside this capability and reject unsupported programs.
